purpose: Ablation of Stan-parity warmup changes (acceptance statistic, initial-step heuristic, metric regularisation, restart reference, max depth) against the posteriordb benchmark v1 owalnuts-da arm, to choose the sampler::Sampler defaults.

config_semantics.base: posteriordb v1 owalnuts-da arm: h0 = 0.1, depth 8, 1 min micro-step, 4 refinement levels, delta = 1, dual averaging at 0.8 on CurrentCoarseEndpoint, no initial-step search, diagonal metric shrunk toward unit variance, restart mu = ln(h)
config_semantics.traj: base + DualAveragingAcceptance::MeanTrajectoryAcceptance (Stan accept_stat__: mean over attempted leaves of min(1, exp(H0 - H_leaf)); rejected leaves count zero)
config_semantics.init: base + InitialStepSearchConfig::stan() (Stan init_stepsize doubling/halving at the start and after each metric update)
config_semantics.mu10: base + restart reference mu = ln(10 h) after each metric update (Stan's set_mu(log(10 eps)))
config_semantics.warmup4: traj + init + reg + mu10 at depth 8
config_semantics.all+h1: all with the initial macro step h0 = 1 (Stan's default stepsize) as the seed of the heuristic

starts: uniform(-2,2) unconstrained, SmallRng(seed ^ 0x5eed00000000), as in v1
run_order: models in listed order; configs in listed order; seeds ascending; strictly sequential
estimators: posteriordb v1 driver: ArviZ 0.23.4 rank R-hat, bulk ESS, tail ESS on BridgeStan-constrained draws over the posteriordb reference parameter columns; owalnuts::diagnostics on unconstrained coordinates recorded as a secondary check
primary_metric: seed median of min over reference parameters of bulk ESS / total gradients (warmup + sampling)
decision_rule: Among the configurations, choose the one with the highest geometric mean over models of (config min-bulk-ESS/gradient) / (base min-bulk-ESS/gradient) subject to no model below 0.9x base; that configuration becomes the sampler::Sampler default. If none satisfies the constraint, the best geomean configuration is reported and the constraint violations named; the default flips only if the violations are on models where base fails the gates.
reporting: All cells reported; failures are results; nothing re-run or tuned after seeing results.

predictions.P1: reg alone recovers diamonds and earnings (steps > 0.01, depth-cap rate < 0.5) because the unit-variance prior on the metric is the binding fault on regressions with small posterior scales
predictions.P2: traj alone moves the adapted step on every model (the coarse-endpoint statistic is a different quantity) but is not sufficient on diamonds/earnings
predictions.P3: all reaches >= 0.6x CmdStan geomean ESS per gradient on the nine models
predictions.P4: refinement level > 0 is selected on < 5% of retained transitions in every configuration (WALNUTS runs as NUTS with delta = 1 on these posteriors)
